Title: Cause and Effect special - An hour with Johannes Walch, VEKN Chairman

Messages.Author: Forhead
Messages.Body:
Greetings everyone!

By now most people have read the two open letters concerning the Design Team. It has made so that the community has started to talk about organisational questions and openess, instead of the more common subject of bleed and pool gain. We have invited Johannes Walch to talk to us at Cause and Effect in an effort to shed some light on the current situation and also what the Inner Circle does and what Johannes' role is in the Inner Circle.

The purpose of this post is to ask for your help. There are some post that in the wake of Jeff Kuta's original letter resulted in voices being raised to have more openess and to rework the paradigm White-Wolf left behind. This lead us, the Cause and Effect team, to have Johannes join us for an hour or so of questions for him from the community.

Any question that you would like Johannes to answer can be asked here or sent to  . We'll try to make sure that every question get asked to Johannes, but as you might imagine it depends on how many that gets asked.

The show will be broadcasted live, as always, on Tuesday the 13th of March at 20.00 o'clock (CET) and you will also be able to ask questions and follow-up questions at the end of the show.

Isak Esbjörnsson Bjärmark

Messages.Author: Forhead
Jesper
Messages.Body:
In random order, here is something to get you started:

“Is there, in your view, a difference between how a non-profit organization based on volunteers work, and how a company who lives for profit work?”

“After what criteria was the IC selected?”

“After what criteria was the design Leader and the designers for the new set selected?”

“After what criteria was the play tester and play tester coordinator selected?”

“Could you see v:ekn based on a openness criteria where all information was open and every one could access it?”

“If not, why?, what top secret stuff do we have?”

“As an organisation, which is based upon a game about intrigue, betrayal, blackmail and manipulation. What steps would you take to eliminate these same characteristics in the inner workings of the v:ekn”

"Would you, both as chairman but also as part of the IC, revaluate the way v:ekn is working”
